data.name: My Knife Farm [UPD]
data.description:
👋 Welcome to My Knife Farm!

🎁 JOIN GROUP FOR FREE +1.5x LUCK BOOST 🎁

💤 PACKS OPEN AND MONEY GENERATES WHILE YOU ARE OFFLINE 🤑

📦 Open - Open crates to get knives, from Common to Exclusive!
🌟 Upgrade - Upgrade knives to earn even more money!
💸 Earn - Get better knives to make more money and be the best!
💎 Skins - Some knives have rare skins which are worth more!

💻 Play Anywhere — Works on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console. Full Controller Support!

🟢 NEW VERSION 2.0
+ Inventory System
+ 2 New Spin Wheels
+ Luck & Cash Potions
+ Storage Upgrade
+ Revised Time & Daily Rewards
+ 1 New Case
+ 3 New Knives
+ Tiny Bug Fixes
